header.title: Controller Parameters & Calibration
header.description: Read and write the parameters the firmware actually exposes: payload, feed-forward scaling, per-joint gains and soft limits, and the firmware self-test.

payload.title: End-effector payload
payload.desc: Mass and centre of mass of the tool/workpiece, used by the gravity feed-forward (feed-forward items 4 and 5).
payload.clampHint: The firmware silently clamps these values (mass to ≥ 0, COM to ±1 m) instead of rejecting them, so the line above shows the read-back value, not what was sent.

gravity.scaleHint: Feed-forward gain per joint; 1.0 is the firmware default.
gravity.vectorHint: Gravity unit vector in the base frame (feed-forward scalar item 6).
gravity.empty: No joint parameters read yet — the feed-forward channels follow the reported axis count.
gravity.channelHint: The firmware feed-forward vector is fixed at 7 channels and this arm reports {{count}}, so only these are shown. Saving still writes all 7.

joints.title: Per-joint gains and soft limits
joints.desc: MIT stiffness/damping/torque clamp, and the soft limits the control page takes its slider ranges from.
joints.factoryConfirm: Restore all parameters to factory defaults? This cannot be undone.
joints.persistHint: The firmware requires the arm to be disabled for flash writes, and rejects these while the drives are still enabled.

diagnostics.title: Firmware self-test
diagnostics.desc: Kinematics self-test plus link diagnostics (CRC errors, FIFO drops).
diagnostics.empty: Run the self-test to read the firmware's diagnostics counters.

activation.title: Device activation
activation.desc: This arm's activation state and device UID. An unactivated arm is refused by the firmware.
activation.uidHint: Give this 24-character hex string to your supplier to obtain the activation license for this machine. It is bound to this arm; another arm needs its own.
activation.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the UID above and copy it manually
activation.locked: This arm is not activated, so the firmware refuses to enable it. Give the device UID above to your supplier; once you have the license, it can be activated.
activation.activatedHint: This arm is activated and can be enabled normally.
activation.unreadableHint: The activation record could not be read this time: the firmware may not have the command, or the reply was lost. Press Refresh to retry; if it never reads, check the firmware version.
activation.unsupportedHint: This firmware has no activation query command (activation exists from firmware 1.8.0). Update the firmware first.
activation.offline: No arm connected — connect first to read the activation state.
